title: Pitches from male borrowers that are longer in length may predict slower funding.
Mentioning environmental benefits in sanitation pitches may accelerate funding for women.
Details regarding personal hardships may accelerate funding for women but slow it for men.
Mentioning previous business success in agricultural pitches may predict slower funding for women.
Female borrowers who mention previous loan repayment or microfinance eligibility may fund more slowly.
Female borrowers who mention previous loan repayment history may fund faster.
Specifying the loan amount in local currency may accelerate funding for female borrowers.
Detailed descriptions of the local environment or external challenges may predict slower funding for women.
Female borrowers who mention professional values, such as customer service, may fund faster.
The use of the specific phrase 'hardworking entrepreneur' in female pitches may predict slower funding.
Mentioning specific institutional or brand names predicts slower funding regardless of gender.
Female borrowers who mention dreams or future aspirations predict slower funding.
Female borrowers who list specific products or goals beyond family welfare fund faster.
Female borrowers who explicitly state their age fund more slowly.
Explicit expressions of gratitude to lenders accelerate funding for female borrowers.
Specifying the number of years the business has operated predicts faster funding regardless of gender.
Female borrowers who mention benefits to their family or community fund faster.
Mentioning benefits for children predicts faster funding regardless of gender.
